# `company.fixed_asset_depreciations`

Depreciation periods posted, each linked to the journal entry that posted it.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this posted depreciation period. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_fixed_asset_depreciations_item | items.id | Fixed-asset item depreciated. |
| `period_number` | INTEGER | no | — | — | ix_fixed_asset_depreciations_item | — | One-based period of the schedule this row posts. |
| `period_start` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `period_end` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Depreciation posted for the period, in home-currency minor units. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the amount. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_fixed_asset_depreciations_transaction | transactions.id | Journal entry that posted it; the period stays posted while the entry is posted. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the period was posted. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal who posted it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was posted through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the depreciation run that wrote it. |
